text: Yosin provided us with a very detailed and lively tour. Historically knowledgeable and had a good answer to every question. Absolute recommendation!!
author: bruno_i

title: Wonderful building and views
text: A wonderful building, superb views and gardens, an excellent guide named Alex, and well-organised transportation from the port.
author: MICHAEL_C

title: Private tour of the magnificent Alhambra
text: A taxi picked us up from the gangway to our cruise ship right on time. The journey was smooth and comfortable each way. Our guide Alex Mauri, met us at the entrance to the Alhambra and we could not have wished for someone better. He was knowledgeable but more than that he guided us at a suitable pace and catered to our every need. Conversation between us flowed and we were sorry to wave goodbye. Iechyd Da Alex!
author: HYWEL_H

title: Spectacular
text: The ride to Alhambra with Abdel was great and the tour of the palace with Josef was spectacular. It was worth every penny!
author: Alicia_R

title: Fabulous
text: Alex out tour guide was phenomenal.  Very knowledgeable and helpful.  We had an individual in a wheelchair that needed extra care.  Alex took extra care of pushing her around and coordinating the tour so that the individual could participate.
author: Miriam_R
